exercises.title: Plan the semesters
exercises.task: Write Plan: group topics into semesters so every topic comes after all its prerequisites, each topic as early as possible. Topics of one semester can be studied in parallel. Report a cycle instead of a wrong plan. The spec is in the file.
hints: Count, for each topic, how many of its prerequisites are not studied yet (its in-degree). Semester 0 is every topic at 0.
Build the reverse graph (1.4.1) once: when a semester is done, decrease the count of every topic that needs it; those that reach 0 form the next semester. This is Kahn's algorithm.
When no topic is at 0 but some are left, they are stuck behind a cycle: return the error with all of them, sorted.
